title: The radar screen
description: Pick a target from the tabs or search by name, @mod or #tag. The preview shows what the last scan found and the charge left.

title: Outlines and arrow
description: Veins are outlined through the stone; the arrow under the crosshair shows the distance and height to the nearest one.

title: With shaders
description: Fabric 1.20.1 with Iris and Complementary Reimagined.

title: In a big modpack
description: Forge 1.20.1 in the DeceasedCraft modpack, with the outline colours changed in the client settings. The nearest vein is drawn brighter.

title: Charge
description: The tooltip shows the target and the charge, and says how to recharge when it runs low.

title: Charging Station
description: Burns redstone, coal, charcoal or glowstone dust, or takes FE / Team Reborn Energy, and charges the radar.

title: Paper: outlines for vanilla players
description: With the Paper plugin, matches glow through stone for players without any mod.

title: Paper: compass and action bar
description: On Paper the radar is a compass: the needle points to the nearest match and the action bar shows the distance and charge.
